sources.name: RFEA competition calendar
sources.coverage: Official calendar of the Spanish athletics federation (RFEA). Includes the Ruta (road) discipline with 10 km, half marathon and marathon categories; seasons 2016 to 2027 are selectable.
sources.howToRead: Filter Disciplina = Ruta, then Categoría = 10 km, Medio Maratón or Maratón, and pick the season. The calendar can be exported as PDF or Excel. Only federation-registered races appear, so it is authoritative for dates of big races but misses many small popular races.

sources.name: Finishers: races in Spain
sources.coverage: Multi-sport race listing for Spain (about 500 events): road running, trail, triathlon, cycling and walking, with date and available distances.
sources.howToRead: Narrow to road races with the discipline=road query parameter on the /es/eventos search (also month=1..12 and dmin/dmax in metres, e.g. dmin=42195&dmax=42195 for marathons). Listings link to Finishers event pages, not to official sites, so follow through to find the organizer URL.

sources.name: Correr Juntos race calendar
sources.coverage: Calendar of races in Spain plus some Latin American countries: marathons, half marathons, 10K, popular races and trail.
sources.howToRead: Use the Maratones, Medias maratón and 10K tabs and the province filter (Spain only). Each card shows name, distance, date and city; "Fecha por confirmar" means the date is not set yet. No month filter.

sources.name: HDsports: running calendar for Spain
sources.coverage: Date-ordered list of running races in Spain (with some triathlon and cycling), from short races to marathons and ultras. Each entry shows the current and next year dates.
sources.howToRead: The page is a summary of about 50 entries that links to a full calendar. Each date carries a check mark or a question mark; treat a question mark as unconfirmed. Race names link to HDsports pages, not official sites.

sources.name: CarrerasPopulares.com
sources.coverage: National calendar of popular running races in Spain, with a marathon-only section.
sources.howToRead: The homepage lists races by date under month headings with town and province; "Busca tu carrera" lists the next 30 days across Spain. Distances are not shown in the list. The /calendario path returned HTTP 403 to a scripted request, so start from the homepage.

sources.name: Sportmaniacs races
sources.coverage: Registration and results platform listing upcoming races, mostly in Spain: road, trail, cross-country, triathlon and other events.
sources.howToRead: Filter by province or search by name; entries show only name, date and town, with no distance, so open each race to check it is a road race. Low signal for road races; scan after the other sources.

sources.name: Visit València race and marathon calendar
sources.coverage: Tourism board calendar of road races in Valencia city for the current season, with date, time window and start location.
sources.howToRead: Short list for one city only; use it to catch Valencia 10K and 15K races that national listings miss.
